question: Hello, Oda-san!! The One Piece world has both the Age of the Sea Circle and Age of Heaven calendars. How many years ago do they refer to? What year is it now?
answer: Casual readers probably forgot all about this lol. I'm surprised. You might assume they're both ancient calendars. But to answer, the world is currently in the year 4131 in the Age of Heaven and 1541 in the Age of the Sea Circle. Both are in active use. Incidentally, while we were on the Sky Islands, everything said "about 400 years ago", but really this was rounded to make it easier to understand. You can forget about it.
name: Negizairu
